title: USMLE Step 2 CK integrated review
audience: a medical student in the clinical years preparing for the USMLE
prerequisites: R1, R2, R3, R4, R5, R6, R7; helpful: R8.
purpose: Review clinical medicine with next-best-step questions across internal medicine, surgery, emergency medicine, pediatrics, obstetrics and gynecology, neurology, psychiatry, preventive medicine, ethics, biostatistics and patient safety.
primary_reading: USMLE: Step 2 CK content outline and sample questions

weeks.2: Internal medicine I: cardiology and pulmonology
weeks.3: Internal medicine II: gastroenterology, nephrology and endocrinology
weeks.4: Internal medicine III: infectious disease and hematology

blocks.deliverable: Practice answering next-best-step questions with a fixed method.
Complete two timed blocks and log your errors.
Complete two timed blocks and log your errors.
Week 7 midterm; complete a mixed block under time.
Complete two timed blocks and log your errors.
Complete a full mixed block and repair your weakest area.
Submit the project; take an unseen 180 minute final in week 14.

project: Clinical-reasoning portfolio: for twenty supplied vignettes, write the diagnosis, the next best step, and why each alternative is wrong.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
